edu.title: How Lexicamp works
edu.teaser: The science behind your climb. Tap to learn more.
edu.s1Body: Lexicamp schedules each word using modern spaced-repetition algorithms that predict when a word will be forgotten. Reviews are scheduled at this moment so you remember more while studying less.
edu.s2Body: A word becomes due for review when its predicted memory strength drops toward forgetting. Recall it successfully and the next review moves further out; miss it and its reviews return sooner.
edu.s3Title: Getting the most out of it
edu.s3Body: Rate your recall honestly, as your progress is only as good as your feedback. Short daily sessions beat intermittent cramming.
edu.dismissA11y: Hide the "How Lexicamp works" card. You can review it anytime from Settings.

progress.cefrIntro: CEFR is the standard scale of language proficiency. Lexicamp maps your mastered-word count to an approximate level as you climb.
progress.cefrNote: Levels are approximate: Lexicamp counts individual word forms, so thresholds sit below research baselines.
progress.fsrsIntro: A word's stability is how many days your memory holds it before the next review. Higher stability = higher tier.
progress.fsrsNote: 30+ days of stability = mastered, the same threshold that advances your mountain tier.

progress.accuracyTip: Around 90% is the sweet spot: the scheduler aims for challenge without failure. Much higher means your reviews could stretch further apart.

onboarding.welcomeTitle: Your mountain guide to lasting vocabulary.
onboarding.welcomeSub: Learn smarter with science-backed spaced repetition.
onboarding.s1Title: Most words slip away within a week.
onboarding.s1a: You look up a word, feel that click of understanding, and days later it's gone. Studies put the loss as high as 80%.
onboarding.s1b: It isn't a flaw in you. It's how an unused memory fades. Every forgotten word is effort you didn't get to keep.
onboarding.s2Title: Your brain forgets on a curve.
onboarding.s2a: Words don't vanish at random. Memory decays on a predictable curve: Ebbinghaus mapped it in 1885, and modern research confirms it.
onboarding.s2b: But the curve has a weak spot: review a word at just the right moment and the memory rebuilds stronger, fading slower each time.
onboarding.s3Title: Catch each word right before it slips.
onboarding.s3a: That 'right moment' is the heart of spaced repetition. Lexicamp shows each word just before you'd forget it, never too early, never too late.
onboarding.s3b: Every word is cached like supplies for winter and brought back exactly when you need it. The intervals stretch wider as it sticks.
onboarding.s4Title: Every word has a memory level.
onboarding.s4a: Lexicamp tracks every saved word across five tiers, from Base Camp to Summit.
onboarding.s4b: Each correct review promotes a word up a tier; each forgotten word drops back. The goal: get every word to Summit.
onboarding.s5Title: Lexicamp builds your study deck each day.
onboarding.s5a: Each day the algorithm checks every word you've saved and works out which ones are about to slip away.
onboarding.s5b: Those become today's deck. Nothing falls through the cracks, and you never waste time on what you already know.
onboarding.s6a: That's the summit. Reach it and you'll follow almost any everyday conversation, and it's closer than it feels.
onboarding.s6b: Save a few words a day and let the reviews do the rest. The mountain takes care of itself. Let's set you up.
onboarding.langSub: Lexicamp uses these to translate and quiz you.
onboarding.langPremiumNote: You can add more languages later with Premium.
onboarding.notifTitle: Let the system work for you.
onboarding.notifBody: A gentle daily nudge the moment your words are ready to review, caught at the perfect point on the curve, so nothing slips away.

walkthrough.w1Body: This card is your home base. It shows how many words need review and starts a review session. No words yet? Let's add some now.
walkthrough.w2Body: Look up words here and save them to your word bank. Every word you capture is automatically added to your review schedule.
walkthrough.w3Body: Type a word to see its translations, then save it with one tap. Come back here after the tour to add your first words.
walkthrough.w4Body: Every word you’ve saved lives here. Search, filter, and see word details.
walkthrough.w5Body: When words are due, Study now starts your review session. Let’s look inside one.
walkthrough.w6Body: Tap to reveal the answer, then grade your own recall. Honest ratings help ensure the right words show up in your review queue at the right time.
walkthrough.w7Body: After each session you’ll see your results: how much stronger each word’s memory got and when it comes back for review.
walkthrough.w8Body: See the progress you are making over time. The climb to mastery is not as far as you think!
